control: WGS84 straight-source-edge area of a 1x1 degree equatorial rectangle agrees with an independent analytic ellipsoid latitude-strip integral to 1e-10 relative error
independent_formula: a^2(1-e^2)/2 * [u/(1-e^2u^2) + atanh(eu)/e] integrated over latitude, multiplied by longitude span in radians; WGS84 a=6378137 m, f=1/298.257223563
